comment: Third-party components in the shipped program, one entry each, with where its licence text comes from. tools/gen_notices.py turns this into NOTICES.txt for a package (docs/port/THIRD_PARTY.md, 'Binary-release obligations'). A text is a file ('file'), the first existing of several ('any_of'), or the lines of a source comment from the line holding 'from' to the line holding 'to', with the comment's leading ' * ' removed ('extract'). A missing file is an error. 'platforms' limits an entry to linux or windows packages.

components.name: SDL3
components.used_for: window, input, audio output; shipped as libSDL3.so.0 / SDL3.dll beside the program

components.name: volk
components.used_for: the Vulkan meta-loader, compiled into the program

components.name: Vulkan-Headers
components.used_for: the Vulkan API declarations the renderer compiles against

components.name: Ittiam libmpeg2 (AOSP platform/external/libmpeg2)
components.used_for: the movies' MPEG-2 video decoder, compiled into the program

components.name: miniz
components.used_for: reading and writing the extracted game archive ico.o2r

components.name: Arimo Regular (font)
components.version: 1.341, wght 400 instance subset to Latin (a modified version, OFL 1.1 section 3)
components.used_for: the port's menu text, embedded in the program

components.name: minicoro
components.used_for: the game's fibers (context switch); neither licence asks for a notice, it is included anyway

components.name: newlib libm (fdlibm single-precision functions)
components.version: as linked by the PS2 game; port/math/newlib/ico_libm.c
components.used_for: atan2f, acosf, asinf, sinf, cosf, fmodf, sqrtf with the PS2's results

extract.from: Conversion to float by Ian Lance Taylor
extract.to: Conversion to float by Ian Lance Taylor

components.name: newlib qsort (4.4BSD)
components.version: as linked by the PS2 game; port/math/newlib/qsort.c
components.licence: BSD-3-Clause (The Regents of the University of California)
components.used_for: qsort with the PS2's order of equal elements

components.name: newlib rand
components.version: as linked by the PS2 game; port/math/newlib/rand.c
components.licence: newlib COPYING.NEWLIB item (1), Red Hat, BSD
components.used_for: rand and srand with the PS2's sequence

components.name: MinGW-w64 runtime
components.version: the win-x64 toolchain's (Debian mingw-w64 12.0.0), linked statically (-static, CMakeLists.txt)
components.used_for: the Windows C runtime startup, its support functions and libdxguid's interface IDs, linked into the .exe
